metadata.label: Elemento de Aprendizaje
metadata.description: The governable entity of the model, identified by content and not by location. It is the description of the File plus metadata generated by AI and validated by the Curator. It is published only when it meets the full output contract. It has no term: its validated metadata persists without rework from one term to the next.

descriptiveTitle.title: Descriptive Title
descriptiveTitle.description: Descriptive title of the object, generated by AI from the extracted content. It is not copied from the name of any particular file.

description.title: Description
description.description: Description generated from the extracted text. May live with agent provenance, without human validation.

identifiedAuthors.title: Identified Authors
identifiedAuthors.description: Authors identified from the file or its source metadata, when known. May be empty, have one, or several.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Keywords. May live with agent provenance, without human validation.

type.title: Type
type.description: Format of the object. Distinct from knowledgeType.

knowledgeType.title: Knowledge Type
knowledgeType.description: Institution-configurable classification for the kind of knowledge the element conveys. Axis distinct from cognitive level and from file format. For v1 it is fixed to the revised Bloom knowledge dimension, same criterion as cognitiveLevel while no configurable Institutional Scale exists.

estimatedTime.title: Estimated Time
estimatedTime.description: Estimated time of use or study.

validityStatus.title: Validity Status
validityStatus.description: Whether the object's content is still valid. Institutional, not per course: the curator resolves it from a proposal. Has no replaced value: if something replaces this object, it is a new object in the catalog.

cognitiveLevel.title: Cognitive Level
cognitiveLevel.description: Cognitive level of the object, proposed by the agent and validated by the Curator. Uses the same values as CurricularSection.bloomLevel so it is comparable to the outcome's required level (decision A21: v1 uses the fixed Bloom taxonomy instead of a configurable Institutional Scale).

rights.title: Rights
rights.description: Reuse scope of the object. Derived field: not edited directly. Set to Section only while an approved RightsRestriction points to this element; Institution otherwise. Maintained by business logic (logic/), not by the user. The stored value keeps the name Section for continuity with existing data and with the design documents, but since the catalog anchors on the dictated course it means restricted to one dictated course (Offering), and the interface label says so (lang/*/LearningElement.i18n.json). Renaming the value itself would require migrating every stored element and was deliberately not done.

extractedTextUrl.title: Extracted Text Url
extractedTextUrl.description: Link to the text or transcript extracted from the file, with positional anchors. Product of the Extraction layer; not stored inline due to its potential size.

semanticRepresentationUrl.title: Semantic Representation Url
semanticRepresentationUrl.description: Embedding or semantic representation of the content, generated by the Enrichment layer. Its currency is not asserted by the field name: it is inferred by comparing this field's Provenance record against the active enrichment configuration.

ingestionStatus.title: Ingestion Status
ingestionStatus.description: Progress of the object toward publication. Published requires meeting the full output contract.

metadataStatus.title: Metadata Status
metadataStatus.description: Derived field: true (complete) if every required field of the output contract is present. Recalculated automatically by business logic (logic/), nobody sets it by hand.

evaluationStatus.title: Evaluation Status
evaluationStatus.description: Institutional quality diagnosis of the element against the current rubric. Expired means the configVersion of its Provenance record became outdated relative to the current rubric.

professorReviewed.title: Professor Reviewed
professorReviewed.description: Whether a professor has already validated or corrected at least one of the fields they are allowed to edit, per a Provenance record with origin=Person and actorRole=Professor. Derived and cached by business logic (logic/), same pattern as metadataStatus. Kept separate from metadataStatus because that one also requires curator-only fields (cognitiveLevel, rights, evaluationStatus) to be complete: without this flag, the professor's copy of the IncompleteMetadata task would never have a way to close.

publishedById.title: Published By
publishedById.description: Curator (core_User id) who published the object.
